name: 5-Chloro-αMT
summary: 5-Chloro-αMT, also known as 5-chloro-α-methyltryptamine or as PAL-542, is a tryptamine derivative related to α-methyltryptamine (αMT) and one of only a few known serotonin–dopamine releasing agents (SDRAs). It is also a potent serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and hence may be a serotonergic psychedelic. The drug has been investigated in animals as a potential treatment for cocaine dependence.

pharmacology.text: 5-Chloro-αMT is a serotonin–dopamine releasing agent (SDRA). The EC50 values of 5-chloro-αMT in evoking the in vitro release of serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine in rat brain synaptosomes were reported as 16 nM, 54 nM, and 3,434 nM, respectively. It had a norepinephrine:dopamine ratio of 64:1 and a dopamine:serotonin ratio of 3.4:1, indicating that it is a highly specific and fairly well-balanced SDRA.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin–dopamine releasing agent; Monoamine oxidase inhibitor Possible serotonergic psychedelic

uses.text: The drug has been investigated in animals as a potential treatment for cocaine dependence.

summaryZh: 5-氯-α-甲基色胺（5-氯-αMT，PAL-542）是一種與α-甲基色胺相關的色胺衍生物，也是少數已知的特定血清素-多巴胺釋放劑 之一。在動物研究中，它被發現可用於治療古柯鹼依賴。它可以5-氯吲哚-3-甲醛為原料製得。它在新加坡非法。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It also blocks monoamine oxidase, the enzyme that clears serotonin, which raises the risk of serotonin syndrome and dangerous rises in blood pressure. Related α-alkyltryptamines can cause nausea, muscle tension, a racing heart, overheating and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它還會抑制單胺氧化酶，也就是清除血清素的酵素，因而提高血清素症候群與血壓危險升高的風險。相關的α-烷基色胺類可能引起噁心、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、體溫過高與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它还会抑制单胺氧化酶，也就是清除血清素的酵素，因而提高血清素症候群与血压危险升高的风险。相关的α-烷基色胺类可能引起恶心、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、体温过高与焦虑。

fact.en: It is one of only a handful of known drugs that release both serotonin and dopamine but leave noradrenaline largely alone, which is why it has been tested in animals as a possible treatment for cocaine dependence.
fact.zh: 它是極少數已知會同時釋放血清素與多巴胺、但幾乎不影響正腎上腺素的藥物之一，因此曾在動物身上被測試作為古柯鹼成癮的可能治療方式。
fact.zhHans: 它是极少数已知会同时释放血清素与多巴胺、但几乎不影响正肾上腺素的药物之一，因此曾在动物身上被测试作为古柯碱成瘾的可能治疗方式。
